Construct a fixed-truth data generator

Source: R/generators.R
fixed_truth_generator.Rd

Returns a generator closure that delegates to a user-supplied draw_data function, pinning data_bundle$true_params to the supplied truth for every task. Use this when the data-generating truth is known and constant (e.g. a fixed effect size sweep).

Usage

fixed_truth_generator(truth, draw_data)

Arguments

truth

Named numeric vector; the data-generating parameters, used as true_params and vars_of_interest for every generated bundle.

draw_data

Function with signature (data_spec, task_ctx) returning a list with at least train (data.frame). May optionally return response, test, meta.

Value

A generator function (data_spec, task_ctx) -> data_bundle.

Details

The draw_data function must have signature (data_spec, task_ctx) -> list(train, test, response, ...) WITHOUT true_params/vars_of_interest — those are injected by the factory from truth. It must consume the ambient RNG state (do not call set.seed/withr::with_seed inside).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
gen <- fixed_truth_generator(
  truth = c(beta = 1, sigma = 1),
  draw_data = function(data_spec, task_ctx) {
    n <- data_spec$n %||% 20L
    x <- stats::rnorm(n)
    y <- x + stats::rnorm(n)
    list(train = data.frame(y = y, x = x), response = "y")
  }
)
} # }
